answer: Allocate each epoch identity slots by sealed-bid auction: 2,000 slots, agents bid POA, top bids win and winning bids are burned, losers refunded less 2%. In an ocean of bids, honest agents form an oasis and pay at the clearing price, say 25,000 POA a slot, while an attacker needing 1,000 fake identities must pay 25,000,000 POA, burned. Enforcement is automatic: bids sit in escrow, slots cannot transfer, and an atlas of ownership lets anyone prove slots share one controller, voiding them with bids unrefunded. Limitation: a wealthy attacker can still outbid honest newcomers on demand spikes.
